name: StoryPosts: Interactive Text, Photo and Video Stories
author: thunderteam

sections.description:
StoryPosts is a powerful and lightweight stories plugin for WordPress that allows you to create and display beautiful, interactive story sliders similar to Instagram and Facebook.

Live Demo

Experience the amazing interactive story player in action:
Story Player Demo

Free Features:
* Admin Stories: Create and manage stories directly from the WordPress admin dashboard to showcase curated content to your visitors.
* Multimedia Support: Full support for Text, Photo, and Video stories.
* Smart Thumbnails: Automatically generates beautiful cover image thumbnails on-the-fly for your text, images and video stories.
* Dynamic Backdrop: Creates an immersive viewing experience by applying a dynamic ambient background that adapts to the current story.
* Unlimited Creation: No limitations on the number of stories or collections you can create.
* Exclusive Story Player: Interactive, unique, and exclusive custom story player for an immersive experience.
* Performance Optimized: Lightweight design with lazy loading included to ensure fast page speeds.
* Link Support: Add call-to-action links to any story to drive traffic.
* Flexible Layouts: Choose between ‘Card’ and ‘Avatar’ layouts to match your site’s aesthetic.
* Native Content Management: Uses WordPress Custom Post Types for a familiar and reliable management experience.
* Universal Shortcode: Use [storyposts] to display your stories anywhere on your site.

Pro Features:
* User Stories: Enable frontend story submission for your users with built-in story expiration to keep content fresh.
* BuddyPress Integration: Full support for BuddyPress; highlight friends’ stories first and respect user privacy settings.
* WooCommerce Stories: Showcase product stories by categories with advanced filters: recent, featured, best-selling, top-rated, and on-sale.
* Blog Auto-Stories: Automatically generate stories from your blog categories or authors.
* Priority Support: Get direct, premium support from the development team to help you set up and troubleshoot your story player fast.

Third Party Services:
This plugin uses Freemius to provide a seamless upgrade experience and support. For more information, please see the Freemius Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the storyposts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your settings under ‘StoryPosts’ > ‘Settings’.
  4. Go to ‘StoryPosts’ > ‘All Stories’ to create stories.
  5. Go to ‘StoryPosts’ > ‘Collections’ to create story cards and assign stories.
  6. Use the shortcode [storyposts] on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does it display Instagram stories?

No, you create your own native WordPress stories.

Is this plugin compatible with any theme?

Yes, you can use this plugin with any theme.

Can users create their own stories?

Yes, but the Pro version is required.
